intent: A warm country-wedding gown: a hearth-red kerchief hood with a wheat sprig and a wheat-gold laced bodice over fitted sleeves, a pale linen apron down a two-tier field-green quilted bell skirt, reading from the high camera as a narrow red-and-gold waist above a wide green-and-cream A.
requests: A tapered trapezoid panel primitive: the skirt bell can only be stepped tiers of parallel-sided boxes.
A quilted-cloth material or a cheap quilt-pattern trim, so the overskirt's quilting does not cost silhouette parts.
